title: The Whole Bakery
author: Lior Delacroix
blurb: Ada Brightwater, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
